source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'File Transfer Protocol (FTP)' (PDF 14): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: FTP ka matlab hai File Transfer Protocol. Yeh files upload (apne computer se server par bhejna) aur download (server se apne computer par lana) karne ke liye istemal hota hai. FTP computers ke darmiyan file sharing deta hai. Web developers (websites banane wale) ise aam istemal karte hain. FTP bari files bhi transfer kar sakta hai. FTP ke secure (mehfooz) versions bhi maujood hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek web developer apni website ki files server par kaise bhejta hai?
blocks.explanation: FTP (ya us ka secure version) se files upload karta hai.

items: FTP: files upload aur download; bari files; web developers; secure versions bhi hain.
